original_trigger: Existing pull_request labeled run already created; no additional label or dispatch is needed for its measure jobs.

build.executables: One immutable release executable; all slices download p8-scale-build-37910924354.

preflight.meaning: These are the original repetition-0 samples and remain in the final 150; no duplicate warmup or resampling.

measure.condition: Default job success dependency; all five original preflight matrix jobs must succeed.
measure.repetition_mapping: range(30 * j // 30, 30 * (j + 1) // 30), exactly global repetition j.
measure.fixed_checkout: github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha from this same event, exact C; never use moving main.

aggregate.original_call: matrix.aggregate(build, inputs, output, repetitions=30, shard_count=30, capacity_profile=matrix.CAPACITY_PROFILE)
checks: All five scale/shard0..29 pairs exactly present without duplicates
One source/binary/profile signature and exact per-scale input digest
Global repetitions0..29 in every expected group
All original shard raw validation and source/build bindings
aggregate.failure: A preflight failure skips dependent measure jobs under the existing graph; aggregate still records failed/missing coverage. There is no registered manual partial dispatch that silently fills its samples.

collection_management.count_scope: Use actual official total_count, not this successful-case expectation, for complete pagination.

independent_replay: Keep original b107 per-shard validator unchanged, retain original ZIPs and compact validated returns, then original combine only when all150 accepted.
